welcome_page.title: Welcome to Safety
welcome_page.image_alt: #Street lamp at night with a safety shield
welcome_page.description:
Questions about road safety and personal security during your journeys.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. See the privacy information for details.

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: Safety and Security
sections.description: Questions about safety (protection from accidents or physical harm) and security (protection from crime, harassment, or feeling unsafe) during your usual journeys.

questions.text: Thinking about your typical trip (the trip you make most often in a typical week), how safe do you consider the travel environment to be in relation to accidents and road conditions?

options.text: Not safe at all
Slightly safe
Moderately safe
Very safe
Completely safe

questions.text: When you are on foot, even just to reach a stop or a parked vehicle, how does walking alongside or crossing high-speed roads (e.g., fast-moving or wide multi-lane roads) affect your sense of safety?

options.text: It does not affect my sense of safety
I feel slightly uncomfortable but manage
I feel unsafe and try to minimise time spent near high-speed roads
I take significantly longer routes to avoid walking alongside high-speed roads
I avoid trips that require me to walk alongside or cross high-speed roads
I don't walk alongside or cross high-speed roads

questions.text: Which of the following situations on a trip do you consider unsafe?

options.text: Heavy or fast-moving traffic
Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure (e.g. sidewalks, crossings, cycle paths, lighting)
Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. potholes, debris, uneven surfaces)
Poor visibility or limited sightlines
Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, or pedestrians
Crowding or conflicts with other road users
Absence of emergency services
I don't feel unsafe at all

questions.text: During the day, how secure do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip? (Harassment includes unwanted comments, following, touching, or intimidating behaviour directed at you.)

options.text: I don't feel secure at all
I feel slightly secure
I feel moderately secure
I feel very secure
I feel completely secure

questions.text: In the evening or after dark, how secure do you feel from crime or harassment on your usual trip?

options.text: I don't feel secure at all
I feel slightly secure
I feel moderately secure
I feel very secure
I feel completely secure
I travel in the evening because I have to, but I don't feel secure
I avoid travelling in the evening because I don't feel secure
I don't travel in the evening or after dark

questions.text: Which factors most reduce your feeling of security from crime or harassment?

options.text: Poor lighting (e.g., dark streets, underpasses)
Lack of people around (isolated or deserted areas)
People behaving aggressively or harassing others
Harassment experienced or feared because of my gender
Long waits at stops in the evening
Overcrowding or chaotic environments
Poor visibility (e.g., blind corners, obstructed views)
Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned buildings, graffiti, broken infrastructure)
Lack of surveillance or security measures (e.g., no cameras, no staff)
Previous personal or reported incidents in the area
I don't feel insecure at all

questions.text: When you are on foot after dark, even just to reach a stop or a parked vehicle, how does the quality of street lighting affect your choice of route or your decision to walk?

options.text: Lighting levels have no influence on my travel choices or comfort
I notice poor lighting but it does not significantly change how or when I travel
I still use the route but I move faster, avoid certain spots, or stay on high alert
I take a much longer alternative route specifically to stay in better-lit areas
I do not walk after dark because of poor lighting
I do not walk after dark for other reasons

it.#Street lamp at night with a safety shie: Lampione di notte con uno scudo di sicurezza
it.#<p>Questions about road safety and pers:
Domande sulla sicurezza stradale e personale durante i tuoi spostamenti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome. Consulta l'informativa sulla privacy per i dettagli.
it.#<p>Questions about safety (protection f: Domande sulla sicurezza stradale (protezione da incidenti o danni fisici) e personale (protezione da reati, molestie o sensazione di insicurezza) durante gli spostamenti abituali.
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato al questionario.
it.#Thinking about your typical trip (the t: Pensando al tuo spostamento abituale (lo spostamento che fai più spesso in una settimana tipica), quanto ritieni sicuro l'ambiente di spostamento rispetto a incidenti e condizioni stradali?
it.#When you are on foot, even just to reac: Quando sei a piedi, anche solo per raggiungere una fermata o un veicolo parcheggiato, in che modo camminare lungo o attraversare strade ad alta velocità (ad esempio strade a scorrimento veloce o a più corsie) influisce sulla tua percezione di sicurezza?
it.#It does not affect my sense of safety: Non influisce sulla mia percezione di sicurezza
it.#I feel slightly uncomfortable but manag: Mi sento un po' a disagio, ma gestisco la situazione
it.#I feel unsafe and try to minimise time: Mi sento in pericolo e riduco il tempo vicino a strade ad alta velocità
it.#I take significantly longer routes to a: Scelgo percorsi molto più lunghi per evitare strade ad alta velocità
it.#I avoid trips that require me to walk a: Evito spostamenti che richiedono di camminare lungo o attraversare strade ad alta velocità
it.#I don't walk alongside or cross high-sp: Non cammino lungo strade ad alta velocità e non le attraverso
it.#Which of the following situations on a: Quali delle seguenti situazioni durante uno spostamento ritieni non sicure?
it.#Lack of safe or adequate infrastructure: Assenza di infrastrutture sicure o adeguate
it.#Poor road or pathway conditions (e.g. p: Cattive condizioni di strade o percorsi
it.#Unsafe behavior from drivers, riders, o: Comportamenti pericolosi di conducenti, ciclisti o pedoni
it.#Crowding or conflicts with other road u: Affollamento o conflitti con altri utenti della strada
it.#I don't feel unsafe at all: Non mi sento affatto in pericolo
it.#During the day, how secure do you feel: Durante il giorno, quanto ti senti al sicuro da reati o molestie durante lo spostamento abituale? (Le molestie includono commenti indesiderati, pedinamenti, contatti fisici o comportamenti intimidatori.)
it.#I don't feel secure at all: Non mi sento per niente al sicuro
it.#In the evening or after dark, how secur: Di sera o dopo il tramonto, quanto ti senti al sicuro da reati o molestie durante lo spostamento abituale?
it.#I travel in the evening because I have: Mi sposto di sera perché devo, ma non mi sento al sicuro
it.#I avoid travelling in the evening becau: Evito di spostarmi di sera perché non mi sento al sicuro
it.#I don't travel in the evening or after: Non mi sposto di sera o dopo il tramonto
it.#Which factors most reduce your feeling: Quali fattori riducono maggiormente la tua percezione di sicurezza rispetto a reati o molestie?
it.#Lack of people around (isolated or dese: Assenza di persone (aree isolate o deserte)
it.#People behaving aggressively or harassi: Persone aggressive o che molestano altri
it.#Harassment experienced or feared becaus: Molestie subite o temute a causa del mio genere
it.#Long waits at stops in the evening: Lunghe attese alle fermate di sera
it.#Poor maintenance (e.g., abandoned build: Scarsa manutenzione (edifici abbandonati, graffiti, infrastrutture danneggiate)
it.#Lack of surveillance or security measur: Assenza di sorveglianza o misure di sicurezza
it.#Previous personal or reported incidents: Precedenti episodi personali o segnalati nell'area
it.#I don't feel insecure at all: Non mi sento affatto in pericolo
it.#When you are on foot after dark, even j: Quando sei a piedi dopo il tramonto, anche solo per raggiungere una fermata o un veicolo parcheggiato, in che modo la qualità dell'illuminazione stradale influisce sulla scelta del percorso o sulla decisione di camminare?
it.#Lighting levels have no influence on my: L'illuminazione non influisce sulle mie scelte o sul comfort
it.#I notice poor lighting but it does not: Noto la scarsa illuminazione, ma non cambia come o quando mi sposto
it.#I still use the route but I move faster: Uso ancora il percorso, ma accelero, evito alcuni punti o rimango molto vigile
it.#I take a much longer alternative route: Scelgo un percorso molto più lungo per restare in aree meglio illuminate
it.#I do not walk after dark because of poo: Non cammino dopo il tramonto per la scarsa illuminazione
it.#I do not walk after dark for other reas: Non cammino dopo il tramonto per altri motivi
